description: Android Fragment class providing management functions for a managed profile, including app enabling/disabling, restrictions, intent forwarding, and profile removal.

classes.name: BasicManagedProfileFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing a managed profile, allowing app control, restrictions, intent forwarding, and profile removal.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes app enabled states based on current profile.

methods.name: isApplicationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific app is available and not hidden in the profile.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Binds UI elements and sets initial states.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button click events for various profile management actions.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle switches for app enable/disable.

methods.name: setAppEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an app in the profile.

methods.name: setChromeRestrictions
methods.description: Applies restrictions to Chrome app via DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends a sample text intent to demonstrate forwarding.

methods.name: removeProfile
methods.description: Wipes the managed profile data, effectively removing it.
